newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - NYMEX oil futures face nearby resistance.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - NYMEX oil futures face nearby resistance.

text.p: NEARBY MONTH CLOSE * SUPPORT * RESIST * RSI-14 * MA-10 * MA-20
+NYMEX crude oil, heating oil and gasoline futures are all facing nearby resistance and the key number for June crude is $20.25.
+May Gasoline again faces an overhead obstacle at 63.15 cents a gallon while heating oil is likely to make another attempt to break convincingly through 56 cents.
NYMEX crude oil futures are facing resistance again at the top of the recent trading range and dealers see $20.25 as the next major hurdle.
June NYMEX crude oil closed four cents a barrel weaker on Friday at $19.99 a barrel while May heating oil was just 0.01 cents up at 55.90 and May gasoline was 0.34 cents down at 62.50 cents.
June crude was trading 14 cents down at $19.85 on the after-hours ACCESS system, shortly before the NYMEX open.
"The whole complex is bumping right up against resistance," said Tom Bentz at ING.
"If June crude closes above $20.25 there will be some stops above there," he added.
This level is the highest point reached during this month's sideways consolidative phase.

He saw support first at Friday's low of $19.82, followed by $119.67. "If it falls under that we might be starting to challenge some of the lows at the bottom end of the channel," he said, adding that this support would weigh in at around $19.30.
Beneath this lies the imperfect triple bottom on the June contract chart at around $19.10.

He saw resistance on the gasoline at 63.15 cents a gallon, which is not only a recent high but also corresponds to the 40-day moving average, while heating oil again faced an upside hurdle at 56 cents. "We keep bumping up against this one," he said.

MeesPierson Derivatives in London, using their Market Profile chart technique, saw support for NYMEX June crude at similar levels, namely $19.64 and $19.80. Resistance would be encountered at $20.12, $20.20 and $20.55, their daily report said.
